C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION.IntentSummary:
Deterministic failure localization (D8): firstDivergentBlock over expected V-M-* markers versus observed markers parsed from a caller-supplied log, with BLOCK_* region resolution, foreign-marker context, D8-closed review process context via --review-json, and flake classification consumed not rebuilt.
Authored before production code per A17.3. A41 is normative over §7.3–§7.5; A42 is normative where it differs (route 2 only, corrections 103–107). Build order: pure comparator and parser, then project-wide alphabet split, block location join, module join, review-json filter, flake consult, CLI surface, ngrace-fix skill + mirror.

T-001.Title: Pure sequence tools: parseObservedMarkers and firstDivergentBlock

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: firstDivergentBlock covers seven axes as separate unit cases: divergence at 0, mid, end, observed shorter, observed longer, repeated marker, identical (null); empty sides covered. parseObservedMarkers keeps every occurrence in log order against a project-wide alphabet; cases: empty log, no declared markers, foreign-only, interleaved, repeated. Observed-longer reachable from a real log via repeated emission (A42.6, A40.2).

T-002.Title: Alphabet split, module join, BLOCK_* location resolution

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Expected from V-M-* document order; observed is entry-scoped after project-wide parse; foreign markers reported in log order and never compared (A42.3). Module join via testFiles and linkedModuleIds; ungoverned path is AbsenceValue unable-to-determine (A41.2 corr 97). Divergent marker resolves via parseMarkerBlockName to path:startLine-endLine; no BLOCK_* suffix, no file, multi-file — four-row A42.2 table. No stack-frame location.

Every localization absence uses unable-to-determine (A42.1). --review-json reads ngrace review JSON; only the three D8-named codes pass as process context; table-driven over full REVIEW_CATALOG; closed-by-name rule (A42.4–A42.5). Flag absent → process context absent, no AbsenceValue. classifyFlakeFromEvidence imported; flaky suppresses causal divergence; one fixture per flake verdict (A41.2 corr 98).

ngrace verification localize registered; --log required (--log - for stdin); --review-json optional; text and JSON output; writes nothing (F1). Integration over temp project + synthetic log. ngrace-fix short path; packaged mirror byte-identical; D15 line delta reported. Route (1) not implemented (NonGoals).
